_comment: Proprietary terms, not an open-source license. The plugin reports this POM license as 'ML Kit Terms of Service' with this hash. The open-source code ML Kit embeds ships in assets/licenses/Google-SDK-Third-Party-Notices.txt (app/build.gradle.kts).
name: ML Kit Terms of Service
content:
Google ML Kit (barcode scanning, its vision libraries, native code and models) is proprietary software from Google LLC. It is provided under the ML Kit Terms of Service:

https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms

It is not open source and is not covered by Eko's own license. The open-source code it embeds keeps its own licenses, listed in Google-SDK-Third-Party-Notices.txt.
